messages:
Maria L: quick heads-up — release sweep for the SDK/docs/quickstarts is today at 3pm PT. I want a quick owner rollcall + any last-minute blockers. changelog cutoff is 5pm PT.
Aj Patel: I can own SDK release notes and announce. I have one outstanding PR blocking 0.7.2 packaging: #4821 (needs review)
Liz Chen: taking docs final pass. I'll push a tiny fix for token limits in the quickstart later this morning.
Kevin B: sample-apps owner here. Two sampleapps currently failing CI: image-classifier and chat-streamer. investigating flaky test. ETA ~90m.
Sarah O: quickstarts: I updated the Terraform snippets to the new provider version. No blockers from infra side.
Devex CI Bot: CI status: SDK pipeline: failing (pkg-build: failed on linux-runner-03)
Aj Patel: @Devex CI Bot can you paste the failing log?
Devex CI Bot: ```build.log snippet
error: cannot find libtorch.so
ld: cannot find -ltorch
```
Liz Chen: looks like we need the new builder image. @Oliver G did the image bump land?
Oliver G: I merged the builder image update yesterday but didn't push the release tag. pushing now. once pushed please re-run SDK pipeline.
Maria L: action items so far: @Aj -> review #4821 (SDK packaging), @Oliver -> push builder tag + re-run CI, @Kevin -> triage sampleapp flakes and open followup PRs if needed, @Liz -> docs pass + quickstart small fix, @Sarah -> confirm terraform snippet tests in staging.
Josh R: quick FYI — the telemetry change requires a minor client API adapt (client.config.disableTelemetry). That's in #4830. It's backwards compatible but callout it in the changelog.
Aj Patel: I'll review #4821 and #4830 today. If I can't finish before 3pm, I'll hand off to @Liz.
Kevin B: sampleapp flakes traced to an async race in test harness. I have a patch ready: #4842. Need one more approver. can @Sarah or @Liz take a look?
Sarah O: I can review #4842 after lunch.
Liz Chen: will do docs and can glance at #4842 afterwards.
Maria L: timeline check — 3pm owner sync (quick call) if anything critical remains. otherwise we do frozen merge for changelog at 5pm and cut SDK tag at 6pm PT.
Oliver G: builder tag pushed -> re-ran SDK pipeline. @Devex CI Bot restart request posted.
Devex CI Bot: SDK pipeline: passing on linux-runner-03 (re-run by Oliver G)
Aj Patel: great, starting reviews.
Kevin B: opened PR #4843 to fix flaky test (combined with #4842). added description and test output. please prioritize.
Maria L: final check — who will publish the release notes + tweet thread? @Aj?
Aj Patel: I can publish release notes + community thread right after SDK tag cut (6pm).
Liz Chen: I'll handle the docs release process and update the site deploy notes.
Maria L: awesome. if anything blocks the 3pm call, ping this thread. otherwise see you on the sync. :rocket:
